from.place: ## Proof, first sentence: the proper curve C must first be shown projective; via Stacks 09NZ and 09NX, 09NX proof, second paragraph: the nonvanishing locus X_s is a finite union of affine closed subschemes

title: A finite union of affine closed subschemes is affine
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $Z_1,\ldots,Z_r\hookrightarrow Y$ be affine closed subschemes [def-weil-closed-immersion] whose underlying sets cover $Y$ (the empty family is allowed when $Y=\varnothing$). Then $Y$ is affine [def-weil-affine-spectrum].
